page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i3.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs derived from 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The system is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per core, and includes 1919 GB of bundled local SSD storage. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations indicate average performance across most multi-core and memory operations. The server achieves average ratings in Geekbench multi-core, Passmark CPU, and multi-threaded decompression tests. Single-core performance is relatively weak, as shown by stress-ng single-core and single-threaded gzip compression benchmarks. Memory bandwidth remains stable in the average tier for both cached small-block reads and uncached large-block read and write operations.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.i3.2xlarge offers high storage density by bundling nearly 2 TB of local SSD storage with a moderate compute and memory profile. This makes it highly resource-dense for storage-intensive applications, though users should note the tradeoff of lower single-core CPU performance and poor results in complex tasks like medium-sized LLM inference.

This hardware profile is well-suited for database hosting, Redis caching layers, static web serving, and general-purpose storage-heavy applications. It is less optimal for compute-bound tasks or large-scale machine learning inference.
